description: This PHP source file handles importation of test cases and test suites from XML files into a test management system, including validation, processing custom fields, requirements, attachments, and managing duplicates.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents a test project, used for importing keywords and getting test case prefix.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Represents a test case, manages creation, update, and custom fields.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, manages creation, update, and associated keywords.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user, used for permission checks and author attribution.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Manages hierarchical structure of test suites and test cases.

methods.name: importTestCaseDataFromXML
methods.description: Imports test case data from an XML file into the system.

methods.name: saveImportedTCData
methods.description: Saves imported test case data, handling duplicates, custom fields, requirements, and attachments.

methods.name: importTestCasesFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Processes XML to import multiple test cases.

methods.name: importTestSuitesFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Processes XML to import test suites and nested test cases/suites.

methods.name: check_xml_tc_tsuite
methods.description: Validates the structure of the XML file for test suite or test case.

methods.name: processCustomFields
methods.description: Assigns custom field values to test cases or test suites.

methods.name: processRequirements
methods.description: Links requirements to test cases based on XML data.

methods.name: processAttachments
methods.description: Handles attachment import for test cases or test suites.

methods.name: buildKeywordList
methods.description: Builds list of keyword IDs from XML keywords.

methods.name: getReqSpecSet
methods.description: Retrieves requirement specifications for a project.
